text:
Blood ammonia, hypoxanthine and uric acid rise during repeated sprint exercise. Inosine and xanthine rise too, but less. ADP is converted to AMP, then IMP, inosine, hypoxanthine, xanthine and uric acid. The team note about the urea cycle and creatine pathway doesn't change this, because working muscle clears adenine nucleotides mainly through the purine pathway.

CONFIDENCE: 82
